stories.title: ЕР лидирует на выборах в Госдуму после обработки 83,52 процента протоколов

en.title: United Russia leads in State Duma elections after 83.52 percent of protocols processed
en.summary: United Russia is leading in elections to the State Duma with over 83 percent of voting protocols counted.

stories.title: Кандидаты ЕР побеждают в двух округах Татарстана после обработки 100% протоколов

en.title: United Russia candidates win in two districts of Tatarstan after 100% of protocols processed
en.summary: United Russia candidates have won in two electoral districts in Tatarstan with all votes counted, including Marcel Shaidullin and Marat Nuriev.

stories.title: В Белгородской области "Единая Россия" лидирует после обработки 100% протоколов

en.title: United Russia leads in Belgorod Region after 100% of protocols processed
en.summary: United Russia received 59.15 percent of votes in the Belgorod Region election with all protocols counted.

stories.title: "Единая Россия" побеждает на выборах в заксобрание Оренбургской области

en.title: United Russia wins elections to Orenburg Region legislature
en.summary: United Russia has won elections to the legislative assembly of Orenburg Region.

stories.title: ЕР лидирует на выборах в Госдуму после обработки 82,19 процента протоколов

en.title: United Russia leads State Duma elections after processing 82.19 percent of protocols
en.summary: United Russia is leading in the State Duma elections based on the count of over 82 percent of voting protocols.

stories.title: «Единая Россия» на выборах в Госдуму лидирует в 204 одномандатных округах из 225

en.title: United Russia leads in 204 single-mandate districts out of 225 in State Duma elections
en.summary: United Russia candidates are leading in 204 of 225 single-mandate districts and have secured 57.7 percent of votes on the party list after counting nearly 65 percent of protocols.

stories.title: ЦИК опубликовал итоги выборов в Госдуму после подсчета 50% голосов // «Единая Россия» набирает 57,87% голосов после обработки 50% протоколов

en.title: Central Electoral Commission publishes State Duma election results after counting 50 percent of votes
en.summary: United Russia has obtained 57.87 percent of votes after half the protocols were counted and leads in 161 of 225 single-mandate districts.

stories.title: «Единая Россия» набирает 56,97% голосов после обработки 32,92% протоколов

en.title: United Russia receives 56.97% of votes after processing 32.92% of protocols
en.summary: United Russia is leading with 56.97% based on party lists after counting 32.92% of protocols, with other parties including the Communist Party at 13.95%, LDPR at 9.26%, New People at 8.06%, and Fair Russia at 5.22%.

stories.title: ЦИК: «Единая Россия» лидирует с 57,04% после обработки 25% протоколов

en.title: Central Election Commission: United Russia leads with 57.04% after processing 25% of protocols
en.summary: United Russia is leading in State Duma elections with 57.04% of votes after 25% of protocols were processed, according to election commission data. The Communist Party of the Russian Federation follows with 13.9%, the Liberal Democratic Party with 9.31%, and other parties trailing behind.

stories.title: ЦИК: «Единая Россия» лидирует с 57,7% после обработки 20% протоколов

en.title: Central Election Commission: United Russia leads with 57.7% after processing 20% of protocols
en.summary: United Russia is leading in State Duma elections with 57.7% of votes after 20% of protocols were processed. The Communist Party follows with 14.04%, the Liberal Democratic Party with 9.31%, and New People with 7.93%.

stories.title: ЦИК России опубликовал первые результаты выборов в Госдуму. После обработки 14% протоколов у «Единой России» 57,5%

en.title: Russia's Central Election Commission published initial election results for State Duma. United Russia has 57.5% after processing 14% of protocols
en.summary: Russia's election commission released initial vote counts for State Duma elections, showing United Russia with 57.54% after 13.88% of protocols were processed. The Communist Party ranks second with 13.67% and the Liberal Democratic Party third with 9.27%.

stories.title: Экзитполы: «Единая Россия» набирает около 50% голосов на выборах в Госдуму, на втором месте КПРФ с 14%, на третьем — ЛДПР с 10%

en.title: Exit polls: United Russia receives approximately 50 percent of votes in State Duma elections, KPRF second with 14 percent, LDPR third with 10 percent
en.summary: Three days of voting for multiple electoral levels across Russia have concluded, with exit polls showing United Russia leading at roughly 50 percent.

stories.title: Роспотребнадзор зарегистрировал новый тест на устойчивость к антибиотику

en.title: Russian health agency registers new antibiotic resistance test
en.summary: Scientists at Russia's epidemiology research institute have registered a test for detecting methicillin antibiotic resistance genes using CRISPR/Cas technology.

stories.title: Закупочная цена на маргарин за месяц выросла для производителей хлеба на 15–20%

en.title: Margarine procurement prices for bread producers surge 15-20% in one month
en.summary: Russia's bread bakers union requested the antimonopoly service investigate the justification for a sharp increase in cooking fat product prices.

stories.title: Главные новости к утру 21 сентября // «Единая России» сохранит конституционное большинство в Госдуме XI созыва

en.title: United Russia maintains constitutional majority in new parliament after preliminary election results
en.summary: According to preliminary election results, United Russia secures constitutional majority in parliament with 57.76% of party list votes and leading in 208 single-mandate districts.

stories.title: Госдолг Франции достиг максимума за 50 лет

en.title: France's government debt reaches 50-year high
en.summary: France's national debt is projected to reach 119.3% of GDP in 2026, the highest level since 1978, due to budget deficit.

stories.title: «Нафтогаз» и венгерская MOL построят хранилища нефтепродуктов для Украины

en.title: Naftogaz and Hungarian MOL to build fuel storage facilities for Ukraine
en.summary: Ukrainian Naftogaz and Hungarian company MOL have signed a memorandum to construct fuel storage facilities in Hungary, according to Naftogaz acting board chairman Sergey Fedorenko.
